prompt: A single die-cut vinyl sticker of a five-pointed gold star, like the gold star a teacher puts on a child's notebook. Glossy metallic sunflower-gold (#F6B42C to #E8A01A) with one soft highlight streak, rounded chunky points, flat vector illustration style with minimal shading. Surrounded by a thick, even, pure white die-cut border following the outline. Centered with generous margin on a perfectly flat, solid, uniform magenta background (#FF00FF). No drop shadow, no text, no other objects. Magenta keyed out with ImageMagick floodfill (fuzz 22%), alpha eroded 2px, trimmed, resized to 420px, exported as WebP.
